advancement_policy.rule: do not send every tested model to the holdout

artifact_contract.note: no final trained candidate artifacts in V3.3A

baseline.reproduction: load local artifact OR re-run frozen spec (deterministic rerun proven max-abs-diff 0.0)

calibration_policy.fit_data: inner-train or dedicated calibration split inside the outer-train history ONLY; never outer-validation; never 2025
calibration_policy.rule: no calibration to rescue an otherwise weak model
calibration_policy.selection: calibrated variant must beat RAW on mean inner race-macro LL beyond 1e-4 tie tolerance AND not worsen mean Brier (M-calibration precedent: RAW won)

candidate_families.role: stagewise additive trees; early_stopping forbidden (M4 precedent: no validation-driven training)
regularized boosting, distinct loss behavior vs HGB (M4: materially better raw LL); tests whether regularized boosting closes the gap on the 110-col arm

compute_budget.hardware: M4 MacBook Air 16GB, CPU only, n_jobs<=4
compute_budget.rule: no cloud compute for family screening

diversity_contract.purpose: prepare V3.4 ensemble; a non-winning model may still be a diversity candidate

excluded_families.reason: new dependency; redundant third boosting family; unjustified
new dependency; redundant boosting family; unjustified
redundant with extra_trees (M5: ET >= RF on LL all folds but D2; M6 tuned-ET lineage exists)
no scientific question requires them; dependency/compute cost unjustified; portfolio-driven admission forbidden
contract-incompatible without a preregistered calibration bridge to INDEPENDENT_BINARY; deferred research, not admitted to B/C screening

explainability_compatibility.rule: no rejection solely for explanation cost; cost recorded
explainability_compatibility.xgboost: gain/cover importance + SHAP-optional (shap NOT a dependency; no SHAP requirement)

feature_arms.rule: no model-specific feature sets except preprocessing mathematically required by the family, inside pipelines

firewall_2025.enforcement: ProtectedHoldoutError + development-only resolvers + output season scans in harnesses

holdout_policy.mechanism: ProtectedHoldoutError; HOLDOUT/2025 resolvers raise without allow_protected_holdout=True; assert_no_holdout_request in experiment harnesses

hyperparameter_policy.objective: mean inner race-macro log loss (simple mean over inner folds)
hyperparameter_policy.selection_scope: one configuration per outer fold (procedure estimate, not a global vector)
hyperparameter_policy.style: small preregistered grids; no Optuna/unrestricted search
hyperparameter_policy.tie_break: simpler/more regularized wins (LogReg: smaller C; trees: larger min_samples_leaf, bounded depth, smaller max_features)

known_limitations: single 24-race 2025 holdout at the end (CIs honest, not overstated)
thin/medium history-bin descriptives persist from V3.1
uncalibrated boosting raw LL historically weak (M4) — calibration policy is the remedy path, not feature changes

metrics.primary_rule: simple mean of per-race log loss; lower is better; race is the statistical unit
metrics.selection_rule: never on ROC AUC or accuracy alone; probability quality required

oof_prediction_contract.convention: existing Model Lab identity columns + synchronized top-k adapter; never normalized
oof_prediction_contract.types: PredictionResult BINARY_PROBABILITY / INDEPENDENT_BINARY; state_id-keyed frames (to_frame/from_frame); parquet persistence under ignored data/v3/v3_3*/

preprocessing_policy.family_adjustments: inside deterministic pipelines only (e.g. tree families may skip scaling; scaling must not change selection)
preprocessing_policy.forbidden: fitting on validation/holdout; zero-fill; global imputation
preprocessing_policy.frozen: median/mode imputation, StandardScaler numerics, most-frequent booleans unscaled, MISSING-sentinel + train-vocabulary one-hot categoricals; fit TRAIN only

reproducibility.caveat: exact binary reproducibility may differ across library versions/platforms; rerun-identity asserted within the frozen environment
reproducibility.ordering: stable input + feature ordering (canonical registry order + contract order)
reproducibility.threads: n_jobs<=4 where applicable; thread policy recorded

serving_compatibility.implications: joblib artifacts via FrozenWinnerPredictor pattern; tree ensembles larger memory/latency than LogReg; no new serving dependencies admitted in A (sklearn + xgboost already in footprint)

statistical_comparison.forbidden: driver-state observations as independent bootstrap units
statistical_comparison.method: paired race-level bootstrap, seed 42, B=2000, 95% percentile CI on mean delta

task.name: winner
task.rule: binary per-driver P(is_winner | causal state at T); never normalized across the field; no field softmax

temporal_consistency.report: fold-wise D1/D2/D3 deltas vs baseline for every candidate
temporal_consistency.rule: no every-fold-must-improve veto; instability is material evidence

temporal_folds.resolver: raceintel.model_lab.splits.get_split; M0 count audits enforced on materialize
